LO-Rib

Metal Roofing and Cladding

LO-Rib Metal Roofing & Cladding’s unique rib design allows the panel to curve to the shape of arch buildings or curved roofs. The low profile also makes a great liner panel for buildings.

Specifications

  • 28 gauge Hi-Tensile steel
  • Standard lengths from 4′ to 35′.
  • Comes in a wide choice of attractive colours or Galvanized Plus and Galvalume Plus material
  • Suitable for arching to half round applications and interior ceilings and wall liners
  • Architectural design flexibility
